messages:
marta: quick design question I've been iterating on the p95 marker UX in the latency heatmap. Two options: inline mini-CTA in the legend (compact) vs a stacked control beneath the heatmap. leaning toward compact but worried about discoverability on small screens. thoughts? sasha: compact wins for desktop density. but if we hide labels to save space on mobile we must preserve discoverability (tooltip on tap + keyboard focus). oliver: agree w/ sasha. another concern: customers expect to control sampling rate. if CTA toggles sampling we should expose current rate e.g. "Sampling: 1 in 100" next to the control. ying: microcopy suggestion: avoid the word "CTA" :D instead: short action label like "Collect latency" or "Share latency data". tooltip can expand with privacy blurb. marta: good nit. short label candidates: "Collect latency", "Share latency", "Send samples". which reads best next to the p95 line? sasha: "Share latency" feels ambiguous. "Collect latency" might sound like we're capturing payloads. "Send samples" is terse but technical. maybe "Share latency data" (shortened to "Share latency" on small screens). oliver: add the sampling rate below in smaller text: "Sampling 1 in 250". we should also show an estimated monthly event count so customers understand volume. tiny text: "~12k events / mo" ying: a11y: ensure the control is keyboard reachable and has aria-pressed when used as a toggle. also tooltip must have role=\"dialog\" if it contains interactive controls (link to privacy or a slider to change sample rate). marta: prototype has a mini-slider in the tooltip for "adjust sample rate". is that too heavy? sasha: sliders in tooltips are risky for keyboard nav. prefer a link to a small modal with the slider so focus management is explicit. design-bot: Prototype updated: legend compact -> icon+label on >=420px, icon-only under 420px, tooltip links to "Adjust sampling" modal. oliver: UX test plan: A/B test compact legend vs stacked control for time-to-toggle and task success for first-time users. Metric: median time to find 'share' control and percent who toggle within 2 minutes. ying: copy inside modal: header "Adjust latency sampling" body "Sampling controls how many request timings are sent to us. Data is anonymized and excludes user content." small label: "Estimated events per month: ~{estimate}" footer: link to privacy. marta: can we include a short code snippet for aria pattern for modal? dropping example: ```

Adjust latency sampling

``` sasha: perfect. devs: remember to trap focus in modal and restore focus to trigger on close. also keyboard shortcut for closing (Esc). oliver: product question: should sampling be org-level default or per-project? affects wording: "Enable sampling for this project" vs "for your organization". product to confirm. ying: accessibility nit: color contrast for the mini-icon in legend on top of heatmap must meet 4.5:1. use a subtle outline or backdrop. marta: thanks all. next steps: i'll update figma with modal flow + copy variants. oliver, can you write the A/B test brief? sasha, please confirm breakpoint behavior with devs.
